title: The Substrate Cycle
narrativeSpine: Two stories trace authority after material abundance into the ownership of reality’s underlying rules and categories; an opening flood decision binds collective choice to irreversible cost.
firstSceneDraft: The Substrate Cycle asks who controls reality after ordinary scarcity changes shape.
Its two linked stories connect abundance with power over the systems beneath it.
The opening places a city beside a deliberately scheduled encounter with the sea.
A collective decision becomes difficult because its costs belong to particular lives.
visualActionProposal: A city’s flood gate divides residents on a single balcony; allocation tools expose competing consequences before the machinery can move.
